name: zerotrace
title: ZeroTrace — secret & PII guardrail
summary: Scan staged changes (or an AI-agent payload) for secrets and PII, explain each risk, and propose a human-approved fix. Local-first: no value leaves the machine.

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Findings for the staged diff, as fingerprints (never values).

commands.name: gateway
commands.description: Sanitize an agent/MCP/RAG payload: masks secrets and PII, neutralises prompt injection.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: Check the install, config layers and model endpoint.

network: none by default; an optional local or company-hosted model endpoint
